decisions.reason: As a low-cost compilation close to the established offer, its unresolved demand still makes it an inexpensive option worth keeping open.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP builds directly on the firm's core reissue expertise, so the option remains valuable enough to keep despite uncertain sales.
The multi-disc box set is costlier to stock and produce, and with no evidence of demand the firm abandons this more expensive option.
This low-cost compilation CD is close to the established catalog, so keeping the option open is inexpensive while demand remains uncertain.
